DCP Numeric Controls
9 controls extracted
Source: Camden DCP
|
Development type: dwelling house
Setbacks
Front setback
≥ 4.5 m
Lot <= 900m2 (Table 4-2). Applies where there are not 2 dwelling houses within 40m on the same side of the primary road; otherwise the setback is the average of those 2. A reduced 3.5m applies only where the development fronts open space. Tiers >900-1500m2 = 6.5m and >1500m2 = 10m are NOT yet stored.
p. 11

≥ 0.9 m
p. 11

≥ 2 spaces/dwelling
3+ bedroom dwelling: minimum 2 car spaces
p. 21
Landscaping & Canopy
Minimum landscaped area
≥ 30 %
Minimum 30% of site area as landscaped area; areas <1.5m wide excluded; min 40% of front setback landscaped
p. 17
Minimum landscaped area
≥ 30 %
p. 17
Minimum deep soil zone
No set number
No separate deep soil control; DCP uses 'landscaped area' (30% of site). Deep soil planting areas must be provided within landscaped area but no separate numeric minimum
